name: SCVD General Store
description: An x402 store on Base and Solana where AI agents buy signed goods with USDC and get a cryptographic receipt anyone can verify against the chain for free, with no account. SCVD also runs a free conformance desk that checks any issuer's x402 signed offers and receipts, publishes the open-source verifier and signer behind it (x402-verify and x402-sign on npm), and publishes a weekly signed, Bitcoin-anchored corpus of x402 ecosystem observations.
